summary:
Review of direct check 495d49f163e24e3f951df60c6779ec27 (unit-claim-install-snapshot-alignment), preflight-validated with valid=True and no diagnostics.

Fresh execution 3d53c8e244184b0490a87411aabe15f4 completed the comparison: the declarative prerequisite longer-tail matched, comparison_complete and witness_complete are true at witness index 1, and the assertion evaluated false. A log seeded through index 5 was given a snapshot at index 3; the install was accepted (rejected false), lastApplied and the snapshot index became 3, compaction left two entries above the snapshot, and the receiver's effective last entry stayed (5, term 1), so within_installed_snapshot is false.

Product contents: the required checker_correspondence item (no_issue_found, empty counterevidence) covering requirement versus predicate, caller duties, identity/correlation, the event-based oracle (exit 0 while the predicate is false), completion, and all disclosed adaptations; an applicability item; and resolutions for the two open issues 7bcba806871948e49b8891aa6bd2c2b7 (claim) and 249524635d7742fc8fb619966362537f (harness legality), both disposing the snapshot-protocol condition as independent_scope with sources.

Explicitly retained, not hidden: the tail was seeded into the caller-owned LogStore rather than produced by a real leader; goroutines were disabled with a substitute answering restore futures, so only the handler's bookkeeping is isolated; TrailingLogs was set to 0 so compaction was not skipped; the single node has no peers, so no vote, election or quorum consequence was measured; and the question of whether removal by the next AppendEntries is always timely enough is kept as an open boundary rather than folded into the claim. No verdict beyond the recorded comparison is asserted; confirmation depends on this review's acceptance, which would make four in-scope violations (batching-FSM ConfigurationStore delivery, heartbeat fast-path header gate, TimeoutNow sender attribution, and snapshot install log-tail alignment) recorded with the first three already confirmed.
